subject: Three-way CTO / VP intro + demo — confirm availability
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@quantumgrid.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + demo request — QuantumGrid evaluation

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the quick response to our RFI. We're evaluating inference platforms to replace an in-house stack and would like a short executive intro followed by a targeted demo focused on: multi-tenant performance, private deployment options, and cost controls.

Who from your side should be on the call if our CIO (Emma Liu) and VP of Infrastructure (Alex Taylor) join? Ideally we'd have a senior product/ops person plus someone who can speak to dedicated/private deployments and SLAs.

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Aug 18: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Wed Aug 19: 09:00–11:00
- Thu Aug 20: 14:00–16:00

We're aiming for a 60–75 minute block (30 demo + 30 Q&A + 15 buffer). I've attached a short blurb on our priorities — "QG-req-brief.pdf" — and a first-pass list of security questions we may share after the demo.

Can you confirm who would attend from Redwood and which of the windows work?

Thanks,
Emma Liu
CIO, QuantumGrid
emma.liu@quantumgrid.com
(attachment: QG-req-brief.pdf)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-08-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo request — QuantumGrid evaluation

Hi Emma — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the brief.

We can absolutely cover the areas you listed. Tentatively I'd propose:
- Soojin Lee — Solutions Lead (intro + orchestration/routing/fallback)
- Marissa Cole — Product PM (demo walkthrough + UX)
- Karthik Iyer — Head of Platform (private deployment, SLAs, dedicated capacity)

All three can join; I need to confirm Karthik's calendar but the windows you listed look doable.

Can you lock in Thu Aug 20 14:00–15:15 PT? If that works for you I'll send a calendar invite with an agenda and we'll schedule a 30-min internal sync for Redwood at 13:30 PT that day.

Proposed short agenda (we'll attach a polished version if you want):
- 5 min intros & objectives
- 25 min focused demo (deployment modes, cost controls, SLAs)
- 25 min technical Q&A / security touchpoints
- 10 min next steps & mutual action plan

If Aug 20 is tight, Wed Aug 19 09:00–10:15 PT is our second choice.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai
(attachment: none)

Soojin / Karthik — I can do Aug 20 14:00 PT. I think it makes sense for me to run the demo portion and for Karthik to handle the deployment/ops questions.

Two asks:
- Karthik, can you bring a 2–3 slide summary on our private deployment options + quantization/latency tradeoffs? Will save time in the Q&A.
- Soojin, I'll draft the demo deck and attach a concise agenda (30m demo flow).

Also recommend we join the call from our office network (not VPN) so we can pull perf numbers if they ask.

-Marissa
Product Manager, Redwood Inference
